verdict.rationale: Flagright's llms.txt documents an official hosted MCP endpoint for AI clients such as Claude Code and Cursor. The endpoint sits on the docs domain, so the evidence supports agent access to documentation rather than to Flagright's compliance operations (users, transactions, cases, rules). Missing for 10: evidence the MCP server exposes product API actions or data, documentation of its tools, auth and scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: For AI client integration (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), connect to the MCP server at https://docs.flagright.com/_mcp/server
